P09 plan. Fit the loop's steps, no second checkout: for a judged problem, measure() runs 'run' on every case in the scratch problem folder and returns samples = {id -> output}. decide(kept, cand) asks 'compare' twice per case (a=kept,b=cand and a=cand,b=kept). Per case: +1 when the candidate wins both orders, -1 when kept wins both, 0 otherwise (a split = position bias, counts as a tie). Keep only when a one-sided sign test on the +1/-1 cases gives p<0.05. Length bias: a length control. For the cases the candidate wins, also ask compare(kept, kept padded to the candidate's length); when the padded kept output wins as often, the win is from length, so refuse with that reason. value for the report: the candidate's win share vs the kept version (baseline 0.5).
